user_outcome: Agents can no longer choose an action from malformed, incomplete, unknown-key, or tied utilities; humans receive a typed specific repair or an explicit inconclusive tie without paying for forecast work first.
implementation: Added shared exact-key, finite-numeric utility-matrix validation.
Rejected unknown actions, unknown scenarios, missing feasible-action rows, missing governed scenarios, flat rows, booleans, strings, NaN, and infinity with INVALID_UTILITIES.
Added an instance-specific executable gnomon_decide utility repair.
Validated utilities at the public boundary before forecasting.
Changed exact top expected-utility ties from alphabetical selection to an inconclusive abstention.
Made the agent-facing schema describe the exact nested numeric matrix.
